content_snippet: Myriota raises roughly $40 million in a first close of a Series C round to hire staff and scale satellite constellation

title: HPE Gives Outlook That Falls Short of Optimistic Estimates
title_en: HPE Gives Outlook That Falls Short of Optimistic Estimates
author: Bloomberg
content_snippet: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Co. gave a revenue forecast for the current quarter that fell short of the most optimistic estimates …
summary_en: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) reported fiscal Q4 revenue of $14.5 billion, a 50% year-over-year increase, beating analyst estimates of $14.3 billion. Despite the strong headline figures, the company's Q1 revenue guidance fell short of the most optimistic analyst expectations, triggering a 6%+ decline in after-hours trading due to concerns over the sustainability of high-growth AI server demand.

title: How Jensen Huang ended up as Nvidia CEO again
title_en: How Jensen Huang ended up as Nvidia CEO again
author: Emma Roth
content_snippet:
The Jensen Huang era of Nvidia nearly came to an end this month. Huang, who three decades ago co-founded what’s come to be considered one of the most important companies in AI, resigned from his role on November 12th over mounting scrutiny around his alleged affairs. Huang admitted he had been “unfaithful” to his wife and that he “created problems for the board.”

Huang’s resignation came after weeks of escalating problems, both personal and professional. First, reporting from The New York Times

Nvidia's board has reinstated Jensen Huang as president and CEO, six days after its chair said directors did not intend to bring him back.

The board voted unanimously to reinstate Huang as president, CEO and a board member, effective immediately, the company said on Monday. It followed "a series of discussions and meetings" with Huang, after which the board was satisfied with his "candor and ability to lead" the firm.

author: Reuters
content_snippet:
WASHINGTON, Nov 23 (Reuters) - US lawmakers from both parties offered sharp criticism on Monday of Nvidia's decision to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO and said Congress must pass legislation to crack down on US chip exports to China and get answers.

Democratic Senator Elizabeth Warren, who is set to chair the Banking Committee starting in January, called the decision to reinstate Huang "reckless," adding the board still owes Congress answers about the company's compliance with US export controls

title: Why using rocks for carbon removal could eventually reduce crop growth
title_en: Why using rocks for carbon removal could eventually reduce crop growth
author: James Temple
content_snippet:
Tech companies are investing a lot of hope and money in rocks.

Google, Microsoft, and others have committed hundreds of millions of dollars to get startups to spread crushed basalt, olivine, or other alkaline materials across farms, in an effort to capture carbon from the air and lock it away. summary_en: Research by CarbonPlan suggests that 'Enhanced Rock Weathering' (ERW), a climate solution heavily backed by Google and Microsoft, faces significant scalability challenges. The study indicates that spreading basalt or olivine at levels required for climate impact may degrade soil health and decrease crop yields; scaling back applications to protect harvests would likely cap the method's CO2 removal potential to under 1 billion tons per year.

summary_en: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent warned that Americans should expect intermittent service outages as government and critical infrastructure undergo systemic upgrades for AI integration. summary_en: In a simulated software development environment featuring project boards, chat logs, and collaborative workflows, leading models like GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 achieved a task completion rate of less than 10%. summary_en: Perplexity has launched the Monitor API, allowing developers to define monitoring goals via natural language for periodic scanning of specific web pages or global information. title_zh: AI推理平台安全漏洞致用户密钥遭大规模窃取
summary_zh: 安全机构Dragos通过模拟测试发现，多家AI推理代理商存在严重的隐私泄露与密钥窃取漏洞，导致用户凭证遭到非法访问与持久化攻击

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 安全研究机构Dragos在2026年7月至11月期间，通过投喂200万条虚假凭证测试发现，多家AI推理服务提供商未能履行数据留存协议，导致AWS密钥、用户请求内容遭到非法窃取。调查显示，部分中间商恶意开启日志记录功能，甚至出现数据泄露至外部聊天平台（如飞书）并在北京、上海等地被迅速访问的极端案例。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Security firm Dragos revealed between July and November 2026 that multiple AI inference providers failed to uphold data retention policies, leading to the theft of AWS keys and sensitive user requests. Investigations confirmed that some marketplace resellers enabled logging to intercept data, with instances of leaked test URLs being accessed within minutes from Beijing and Shanghai via internal communication platforms.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】安全机构Dragos、AI路由服务商OpenRouter、推理平台Novita、Phala、Together及部分未公开第三方在全球性AI模型推理调用API接口及在线算力市场：通过向代理商投喂诱饵数据，揭露了攻击者窃取API密钥、滥用零数据留存政策以及利用内部日志泄露敏感信息的行为
【起因与机理】AI推理市场缺乏统一的端到端加密与安全合规标准，中间商为压低价格牺牲了数据隔离与安全合规性
【关键数据与实测】关键时间节点与后续：OpenRouter已紧急移除违规供应商并撤销125个终端的ZDR认证，受影响厂商正陆续发布初步安全报告。
【涉及范围与推进】核心涉案与合规细节：包括Novita、Phala及Together在内的多家服务商被指出无视“零数据留存”承诺，且存在长期的凭证日志残留。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Dragos (security researchers), OpenRouter, inference providers like Novita, Phala, and Together: Exposure of widespread API key theft, violation of 'Zero Data Retention' (ZDR) policies, and exploitation of internal logging mechanisms
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Lack of standardized end-to-end encryption in the fragmented AI inference supply chain and excessive cost-cutting by marketplace resellers
[Regulatory & Investigation Focus] Core Investigation & Findings: Dragos identified systemic data interception and credential theft, urging stricter oversight of AI middleware providers.
[Key Position & Outlook] Outlook & Timeline: OpenRouter removed non-compliant providers and revoked 125 ZDR certifications, with affected firms currently issuing security remediations.

title: Lean and Mathlib community officially confirms Levent Alpöge's proof of the Riemann hypothesis is correct
title_en: Lean and Mathlib community officially confirms Levent Alpöge's proof of the Riemann hypothesis is correct
author: Matthias Bastian
content_snippet:

title_zh: 斯坦福数学家完成黎曼猜想的形式化证明
summary_zh: 斯坦福大学数学家勒文特·阿尔珀格（Levent Alpöge）通过Lean语言完成了黎曼猜想的证明，并经由Mathlib社区通过形式化验证确认无误

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 斯坦福大学数学家勒文特·阿尔珀格（Levent Alpöge）于2026年11月20日发布了黎曼猜想的证明，该证明包含1700万行Lean代码。Lean与Mathlib社区通过多方独立运行验证，确认了该代码逻辑的严密性与结论的正确性，标志着这一困扰数学界逾百年的难题获得形式化解决。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Stanford mathematician Levent Alpöge published a proof of the Riemann hypothesis on November 20, 2026, consisting of 17 million lines of Lean code. The Lean and Mathlib community confirmed the proof's correctness through independent execution and formal verification, officially resolving the century-old mathematical challenge.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】勒文特·阿尔珀格（Levent Alpöge，斯坦福大学数学家）在Lean与Mathlib形式化验证社区：完成黎曼猜想的形式化证明，并经多方独立运行代码验证通过
【起因与机理】作为数学界最重要的未决问题，其对于素数分布规律的解释具有基础性地位
【关键数据与实测】斯坦福数学家勒文特·阿尔珀格通过1700万行Lean代码破解黎曼猜想。
【各方立场与态度】解决时间远超Metaculus预测（2035年）及陶哲轩预判（2050年）。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Levent Alpöge, Mathematician at Stanford University: Completed the formal proof of the Riemann hypothesis verified by independent code execution
[Root Cause & Mechanism] It is a foundational problem regarding the distribution of prime numbers
[Key Technical Spec] Levent Alpöge solved the Riemann hypothesis using 17 million lines of Lean code.
[Key Position & Outlook] Solved much earlier than Metaculus predictions (2035) and Terence Tao's estimates (2050).
